I add ~4pp for ZEC's demonstrated fat left tail (-50% in 48h on 4-5 Jun 2026 after the Orchard soundness flaw; two critical vulns surfaced within three months) and for the parabolic-top setup (RSI >75, volume -51% off the $1,249 high, -5.35% on the day). No prediction market prices this contract, so no crowd anchor.

All three are reconstructed from reported daily moves; none retrieved a fitted series, and I could not either. I take ~23%, mid-range, which puts the threshold at ~1.05 sigma. The spread among the runs does not change the answer by more than ~3pp.
